title: Elephant random walk on the infinite dihedral group $\mathbb{Z}_2 * \mathbb{Z}_2$
summary: Elephant random walks were studied recently in \cite{mukherjee2025elephant} on the groups $\mathbb{Z}^{*d_1} * \mathbb{Z}_2^{*d_2}$ whose Cayley graphs are infinite $d$-regular trees with $d = 2d_1 + d_2$. It was found that for $d \ge 3$, the elephant walk is ballistic with the same asymptotic speed $\frac{d - 2}{d}$ as the simple random walk and the memory parameter appears only in the rate of convergence to the limiting speed. In the $d = 2$ case, there are two such groups, both having the bi-infinite path as their Cayley graph. For $(d_1, d_2) = (1, 0)$, the walk is the usual elephant…
